severity.contrastNote: Tier 2 carries near-white ink and is the AA-binding step: #8A7706 measured 4.33:1, #7F6D05 measures 4.99:1.

display.purpose: Page h1 in the ruled masthead, tier band level, card titles, button labels. Condensed gothic, uppercase where it labels a section.

headline.purpose: h2, auth card title, account section head.

body.purpose: Prose, table cells, descriptions. Vietnamese-complete with tone marks; 13px under 600px; 68ch max measure.

label.purpose: Field labels, table heads, nav group titles. Uppercase, .12–.22em tracking, never below 11px.

mono.purpose: Reserved for measured values: latency, quota, serials, codes, dates. Always tabular.

shadows.name: shadow-pop
shadows.purpose: Small-travel lift: support FAB hover, raised tile. Light theme uses 0 12px 28px -20px rgba(13,26,30,.35).

shadows.name: shadow-float
shadows.purpose: Dismissable floating layers only: dropdown menu, toast, modal. Light theme uses 0 26px 54px -28px rgba(13,26,30,.42).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default for entrance, elevation, colour settles.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Overshoot for tactile confirmations: checkbox tick, FAB hover, arrow nudge. Brief pins the rive.app feel; disabled under data-motion=low.

motion.name: dur-2
motion.purpose: Small moves: dropdown, toast, theme flip.

motion.name: dur-3
motion.purpose: Structural moves: sidebar collapse, drawer, modal.

motion.name: dur-4
motion.purpose: Measured values: progress bar to its real width.

motion.name: count-up
motion.purpose: rAF count-up on [data-count]; halved to 360ms under data-motion=low.

motion.name: parallax-lean
motion.purpose: Isobar canvas leans toward the pointer. Suppressed on reduced motion, metered connections and non-hover devices.

motion.name: beacon
motion.purpose: Severity heartbeat on error states and tiers 4–5.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: body drops to 13px, strips become columns

loading.name: critical-split
loading.purpose: First paint needs only the shell sheet. Route modules arrive deferred, and .route-view stays held by sheet-pending until both the module sheet and the font sheet resolve.

loading.name: cache-token
loading.purpose: One constant in shell-boot.js plus 14 ?v= refs in index.html; bump together to bust every cached chunk.

loading.name: reduced-data
loading.purpose: Drops ambient motion and halves measured durations on metered connections.

narrative.overview: The console reads as a public storm-and-flood warning board, not a SaaS dashboard. A subscriber opens it at 23:40 on a 3G connection to answer one question — how close am I to the danger line — and the interface answers it the way a hazard bulletin does: a full-bleed severity band, then measured values laid out against published thresholds on hairline rules, then the station board of nodes with their live reporting state. Nothing is centred for effect. Every block is justified by a number that has to be on screen. Dark is a night-watch board: observation-blue ground, cool ink, one acid-lime signal rationed across the whole screen. Light is the same document printed on cool paper — the identical rule system, the identical hierarchy, remapped rather than reimagined. Motion is the rive.app feel with none of the rive.app payload — hand-authored CSS transitions, SVG pathLength and three small rAF loops, tied to measured values and stopped for both the vestibular preference and the metered connection.
keyCharacteristics: Hairline rules carry structure; shadows appear only for floating layers.
One brand signal colour, rationed to under 10% of any viewport.
A five-step severity ramp is the only decorative colour system.
Vietnamese leads, English equals; both set in the same workhorse gothic.
Every measured value is monospaced and tabular, so columns of numbers align.
Nothing delays first paint: shell sheet render-blocking, module sheet deferred and gated.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: --signal is the only brand colour and appears on under 10% of any viewport. If a screen needs more than one lime element, the others are wrong.

rules.name: The Signal Never Speaks as Text Rule
rules.body: Text in a signal hue uses --signal-ink, never --signal. In light theme the two are far apart in lightness because brand lime on paper reads at 1.9:1.

rules.name: The Eleven-Pixel Floor
rules.body: No functional text anywhere is set below 11px, in either theme, at any breakpoint. Decorative letterspacing is capped at .22em and comes down before the size does.

rules.name: The Measured Is Monospaced Rule
rules.body: Values that change, compare or align use JetBrains Mono with tabular figures. Labels use the display gothic. Prose uses the body sans.

rules.name: The Hairline-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A module gets depth from a rule and a background step, never from a box-shadow. Two shadows exist in the whole system and both mean 'this floats and you can dismiss it'.

rules.name: The Colored-Edge Ban
rules.body: A card or callout is never marked with a thick border-left/border-right in a status colour. Status is carried by a glyph, a mono label, and at most a 1px hairline in the status hue.

dos: Do set all functional text at 11px or above, in both themes, at every breakpoint — including decorative letterspaced micro-labels.
Do reach for --signal-ink for signal-hued text and --signal for signal-hued fills only.
Do build structure from --edge / --edge-strong hairlines and background steps before considering a shadow.
Do use gap:1px over a --rule background for tiled mosaics instead of doubling up borders.
Do put measured values in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures, and every value against a threshold the user can see.
Do let any motion that represents a measured value no-op cleanly under prefers-reduced-motion and under data-motion="low".
Do preserve width and layout through every state change: loading buttons, hover reveals, carousel indicators animate on transform, opacity or colour.
Do keep light and dark as the same document: remap the same token names, never restructure for one theme.
Do carry status with a glyph plus text; colour is never the only signal.
Do put the primary action inline on the tier band, not centred beneath it.
donts: Don't put a kicker or eyebrow line above a heading. The bulletin's own furniture — the tier band, the ruled masthead, page-header__meta — carries that role.
Don't thicken a left or right border into a status stripe.
Don't ship the Rive runtime or any external animation dependency. Motion is in-repo CSS/SVG.
Don't let a transition on width, margin or max-width run continuously — one user-initiated toggle is fine, a scroll-linked or auto-advancing layout shift is not.
Don't add a third shadow. Two exist; both mean 'this floats.'
Don't invent uptime, benchmark, testimonial or jurisdiction claims. Numbers come from the backend or mock-data.js.
Don't drop the mono role into a label or the display gothic into a measurement.
Don't paint route content before the module stylesheet is attached.
